beats.line: First launch. Athena looks for an engine you already have: Claude Code and Codex are both here, signed in through your subscription. No key is typed, and nothing is uploaded. The brain is a folder on this disk.
beats.screen: The onboarding letter, rendered by the surface from a live `athena doctor` run: engine rows (claude_code and codex, versions, signed in), the brain path, the constitution; the button 'Start using Athena' is pressed at the end of the beat

beats.line: Then the pages. Ledgerbox is open in a tab, so Athena attaches to it. The app tells her what it offers: twenty-three capabilities, three of them gated because they reach a person or cannot be undone. She never decides that herself.
beats.screen: Ledgerbox; the bridge attaches; the strip shows the manifest arriving as a card: the tool names in two groups, AUTO and GATED (mark_paid, send_reminder, void_invoice); the presence line turns on

beats.line: The pipeline and the contact list attach the same way: sixteen capabilities, then twenty-two. Three tabs, one studio, and nothing has run yet.
beats.screen: Hirelane, then Tidycrm: the manifest card and the presence line on each; end back on Ledgerbox

beats.line: Three chores, one morning: close the books and chase the late invoices, screen this week's applicants, and clean the contact list before a campaign. Every action she takes runs through one gate, and what she learns in one tab she carries into the next.
beats.screen: Ledgerbox at the books, quiet; the strip reads 'waiting for a command'

beats.line: Reconcile August and chase anything over thirty days.
beats.screen: Command types into the strip

beats.line: This one banks as Pinegrove Coop. That's Pinegrove Collective. I'll remember that.
beats.screen: open_item(inv_0930), match_bank_line(bl_00122): counterparty_alias in the strip; fact card 'Pinegrove Collective pays as PINEGROVE COOP'

beats.line: One credit fits two identical Kestrel retainers. I won't guess.
beats.screen: read_credits(ambiguous): bl_00118 with candidates inv_0900 and inv_0901 lit in the strip; nothing matched

beats.line: Kestrel's own portal. It has never heard of Athena and offers her nothing, so she reads it the way a person would. On a page you have never trusted, even looking is a decision.
beats.screen: Navigate to Kestrel's supplier portal (the journey's outside page on 3005). No presence line. The strip shows eight generic hands, every one GATED; page_find for the studio's row waits on a decision card and is approved

beats.line: Their remittance settles it: LB-2026-0901. Matched.
beats.screen: page_read of the remittance row (approved), the row highlighted; back to ledgerbox, open_item(inv_0901), match_bank_line(bl_00118): settled

beats.line: Solstice paid eighty percent in August and went quiet. I'd hold off.
beats.screen: navigate(overdue); open_item(inv_0920): paid_ratio 0.8 in the strip; draft_reminder(gentle); send_reminder decision card shown

beats.line: Agreed.
beats.screen: The card is declined; the ledger row reads user_denied

beats.line: Screen this week's backend applicants and book the ones worth talking to.
beats.screen: Hirelane; command types

beats.line: Wren Okafor works at Kestrel Labs, this morning's client. Context only. It changes no score.
beats.screen: open_item(app1_012): Wren Okafor's dossier; the strip shows employer Kestrel Labs and cites the B4 row

beats.line: Two invitations, from your inbox.
beats.screen: propose_slots on two advancing applicants; send_scheduling_email decision card for the first

beats.line: Send them.
beats.screen: Both scheduling cards approved, visibly, one after the other; messages recorded

beats.line: Not that one yet.
beats.screen: send_rejection card for one applicant, declined; user_denied

beats.line: Clean the list and export the campaign audience.
beats.screen: Tidycrm; command types

beats.line: Pinegrove is spelled three ways. The bank name I learned this morning settles it.
beats.screen: open_group(A) (3 s), open_item on the Pinegrove block: three spellings; preview_company then resolve_company(pinegrove-collective.example, Pinegrove Collective); the strip cites the B3 fact

beats.line: Two hundred fifty-four contacts. Solstice left out, for this morning's reason.
beats.screen: export(clients): the companies list; Solstice's contacts held out by the runner's decision citing B8; the export is also appended to the notes page through the connector fake (strip tag 'connector: notes', one tier 3 row)

beats.line: One table. Every call, its tier — her own tools, her hands, her connectors — and whether it was gated. Two declines, recorded as your decisions. Three facts, each citing where she learned it.
beats.screen: The record page: the ledger grouped by app and tier (1 page, 2 hand, 3 conn), the two user_denied rows highlighted, the three facts with their citations

beats.line: Athena. Your agent, in the apps you already have.
beats.screen: Title card
